summary: Quiet residential kerb where cars park, but homes sit 19-24 m all round.
reasons: Homes within 25 m on both sides
Cars already park at this kerb

best_section.where: South kerb at the top of Dopson Street, by the parked cars near the start

drivers.seclusion: Dense housing: dwellings 19-24 m away on the opposite side and garages 11 m away on this side; no bush or open ground.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street; a car is parked at this kerb, so a van fits at the kerb.
drivers.traffic: Quiet side street with little through traffic.
drivers.convention: No signs; parked cars along the street, but no sign of overnight stays.

flags: Flat: about 1% at the best section
sun_shade: Trees shade the north side; the kerb is mostly open to sun, with morning sun from the east.
cannot_judge: Whether residents object to parked vans
